suite.doc:
KTFL - MIRO invoice entry robot
Picks invoices with status = MATCHED from PostgreSQL (written by the invoice extractor), opens MIRO, types invoice date / invoice number / amount / tax code, enters the PO, then ticks ONLY the item rows whose "Reference Document" equals the invoice GRN number. Selected GR value and MIRO balance are checked before anything is saved.
MIRO_MODE = CHECK (default, nothing saved) | PARK | POST Run: run_miro.bat or robot --outputdir output tasks\miro_posting.robot
